name: redline
description: A tachometer for your Claude sessions: when the needle hits the redline, stop spawning and start finishing.

statusLine.title: Show the count at the bottom of the terminal
statusLine.description: Puts the stage and session count in the status line, e.g. "Idling · 1/7".

fuelGauge.title: Show the fuel gauges
fuelGauge.description: Adds 5H, 7D and CTX dials beside the gauge: your plan's rate limits and this session's context.
